# Pull Request

## 📋 O'zgarishlar Tavsifi

Pull request'ning aniq va qisqa tavsifi.

## 🔗 Bog'liq Issue

Fixes #(issue number)

## 🎯 O'zgarish Turi

Qaysi turdagi o'zgarish?

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ Yangi xususiyat (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Dokumentatsiya yangilanishi
- [ ] 🎨 Style o'zgarishi (formatting, missing semi colons, etc)
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance yaxshilash
- [ ] ✅ Test qo'shildi yoki yangilandi
- [ ] 🔧 Build yoki dependencies o'zgarishi

## ✅ Checklist

O'zingizni tekshiring:

- [ ] Mening kodom loyiha kod style'ga mos
- [ ] Men o'zimni self-review qildim
- [ ] Men kodni izohladim, ayniqsa tushunish qiyin joylarda
- [ ] Men dokumentatsiyani yangiladim
- [ ] Mening o'zgarishlarim yangi warning'lar yaratmadi
- [ ] Men testlar qo'shdim (agar kerak bo'lsa)
- [ ] Barcha testlar local'da o'tmoqda
- [ ] Men dependent PR'larga bog'ladim (agar bor bo'lsa)

## 📝 Qo'shimcha Izohlar

Reviewer'lar bilishi kerak bo'lgan qo'shimcha ma'lumot.

## 🔍 Code Quality Checks

Avtomatik tekshiruvlar (CI bot to'ldiradi):

- [ ] TypeScript: ✅ Passing
- [ ] ESLint: ✅ No errors
- [ ] Prettier: ✅  Formatted
- [ ] Tests: ✅ 198/198 passing
- [ ] Build: ✅ Success
